note: Recent studies report familial heterozygous splice-site/loss-of-function variants exhibiting marked intrafamilial variability from mild learning difficulties to severe global developmental delay.

evidence.text: An inherited canonical splice-site variant (c.2630-2_2630-1del) causing a frameshift and premature stop codon exhibited marked intrafamilial phenotypic pleiotropy across three individuals, ranging from mild specific learning difficulties to global developmental delay with severe intellectual disability and autism.

source.title: Characterization of a novel inherited splice-site variant in MAPK8IP3 expands the genetic and phenotypic spectrum of neurodevelopmental disorders
source.quote: Notably, despite carrying an identical genotype, the three affected individuals exhibited marked interindividual variability in clinical severity, ranging from mild specific learning difficulties to global developmental delay with severe intellectual disability and autism.

evidence.text: Genotype-phenotype evaluations showed that individuals with missense variants tend to exhibit more severe symptoms than those harboring predicted loss-of-function variants.

source.title: Comprehensive Clinical Characteristics, Longitudinal Adaptive Functioning, and Electroencephalogram Activity in MAPK8IP3‐Related Neurodevelopmental Disorder
source.quote: Our genotype and phenotype analysis revealed that individuals with missense variants tend to exhibit more severe symptoms than those with loss of function variants.
